description: Keyword race check for one issue: find open PRs that fix the same problem WITHOUT ever linking the issue, which link-based checks (claims, timelines, X-Ray) cannot see. Extracts the issue's significant problem keywords (filenames like $types.d.ts, identifiers, distinctive terms, quoted phrases), searches and scans the repo's open PRs for overlap, and returns RACE / SUSPECT / CLEAR with per-PR evidence (number, title, author, created date, matched keywords). Field case: sveltejs/kit issue #17465 was raced by PR #17453, which never mentioned the issue. Call this before writing code for an issue that X-Ray calls clear.
name: racecheck_issue
